title: docs(core): fix three JSDoc rendering bugs on the API pages
body:
Three JSDoc bugs visible on angular.dev today:

- https://angular.dev/api/core/Compiler links `AbstractComponentFactory` to
  `/api/core/Compiler#AbstractComponentFactory`, an anchor that does not exist on
  that page. `Compiler` returns `NgModuleFactory`, which is public API.
- https://angular.dev/api/core/TypeProvider renders ``when `Type' is used as the
  token``: a stray quote leaves the code span unclosed.
- https://angular.dev/api/core/ContentChildren and
  https://angular.dev/api/core/ViewChildren print `** Note: ***` literally.
